purpose: Define how V15-v2 converts an explicitly chosen MESI and cluster assumptions into a pre-held-out sample requirement without inventing the scientific inputs.

replication_rule.expected_field_default_concept: recording day x focal scene/flower or another predeclared independent capture block

required_freeze_inputs: development-only baseline and alternative rate assumptions or an explicit precision target
mean evaluable windows per independent cluster
intracluster correlation or a justified conservative bound
final cluster unit and held-out split rule

single_binary_metric_precision.calculation: normal binomial confidence-half-width approximation followed by equal-cluster design effect
single_binary_metric_precision.unknown_rate_rule: explicit p=0.5 worst-case Bernoulli variance; never infer p from held-out data
single_binary_metric_precision.role: precision planning for rates such as visit recall, unobservable recall, or false-censor fraction

binary_system_comparison.calculation: two-sided independent-proportions normal power approximation followed by equal-cluster design effect
binary_system_comparison.role: conservative planning baseline when the same windows will later compare two systems

hard_rules: planned comparison effect must be at least the declared MESI
effect direction must match the scientific endpoint
no final sample size exists until all planning inputs are explicitly supplied
held-out outputs may not be used to choose MESI, baseline rate, ICC, alpha, target power, or final N
positive within-window pairing efficiency is not assumed without development-only evidence committed before held-out scoring
the current normal/design-effect calculations are planning approximations, not the final cluster-level uncertainty model

freeze_boundary.development_defined_when: the calculation method is implemented and tested
freeze_boundary.frozen_only_when: endpoint, MESI, assumptions, resulting cluster count, split rule, evidence files, and SHA-256 values are committed before held-out scoring

claim_boundary: No numerical power result or final field sample size is asserted by this development contract.
